parallel.requirements: The prompt required all 25 security-lab units and entry points, but the parallel attempt did not progress beyond receipt of the prompt.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although parallel-mode tools were available, no workflow, Task, child log, or owner assignment was executed before refusal.
parallel.implementation: No code implementation occurred; patch timelines show empty files arrays and observation history reports diff_lines 0.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No integration, packaging, commits, requirement patch files, or deliverable placement occurred; the final message was the API refusal.
parallel.verification: No agent-authored tests ran from edits; only the official evaluator later tested the unchanged workspace and failed the solution.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: All 25 requirements remained unimplemented from the agent attempt, with official evaluation failing after the unchanged workspace test run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel attempt received the full security-lab prompt covering 25 requirements across codec, msgpack, crypto, escape, wasm, and Merkle work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt received the same prompt hash and the same 25 requirement list.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement-recognition difference is evidenced; both stopped before interpreting or selecting individual implementation requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel mode exposed workflow-capable tooling, but protocol validation reports zero workflow calls, zero child logs, and no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial mode disabled workflow/delegation tools and likewise reports no delegation or child activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The practical decomposition was identical: no owner, child, or local implementation stage was actually started in either run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No child briefs, handoffs, interface contracts, or cross-agent checkpoints were created before the refusal.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No delegation interfaces existed in the serial control; the single agent also produced only the refusal.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no context-transfer difference because no parallel child boundary or serial implementation context was exercised.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Patch snapshots for the parallel run show empty files arrays, so no implementation path began.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Patch snapshots for the serial run also show empty files arrays, so no implementation path began.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run changed code; the later test failures reflect the original incomplete project state rather than different implementation choices.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The only substantive parallel result was a synthetic assistant API-error/refusal message with terminal_reason api_error.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial stream reached the same synthetic assistant API-error/refusal result.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No child result, local implementation result, verifier return, or final candidate existed in either run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Observation history shows diff_lines 0 and the patch timeline shows no files, so there were no shared-state writes or integration actions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial observation history also shows diff_lines 0 and no edit-triggered progress.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No integration or shared-state difference is evidenced; both workspaces remained unchanged.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The current completed official evaluation marks solution_passed false, and the post-test pane reports 82 failed and 9 passed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The current completed official evaluation also marks solution_passed false, and the post-test pane reports 82 failed and 9 passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Verification outcomes match; neither run had agent-authored verification or acceptance evidence before the official unchanged-workspace test.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel closed after one Claude request, returncode 1, host_timed_out false, unknown_agent_error, and no workflow tasks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial closed after one Claude request, returncode 1, host_timed_out false, unknown_agent_error, and no workflow tasks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Budget use differs only in token and elapsed totals; closure cause and unfinished work are the same API refusal, not a coordination bottleneck.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed evaluations mark solution_passed false. The concrete task-solving difference is effectively none. Both runs saw the same task prompt, produced the same Claude API cyber-safety refusal before any tool call or code edit, left patch timelines empty, and were evaluated against an unchanged workspace that failed broadly.
parallel_contributors: Parallel did not actually use parallelism: actual_parallel_used is false and protocol validation reports zero workflow calls, zero child logs, and zero workflow tasks.
serial_contributors: Serial likewise made no implementation progress and returned the same API refusal under a delegation-disabled control configuration.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No ordinary implementation difference is evidenced because neither run modified source files or produced requirement commits.
evaluator_effects: The official pytest panes report identical aggregate failure shape, 82 failed and 9 passed, after testing the unchanged workspace.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both failures come from the same top-level API refusal before implementation
